about: Page-by-page reconciliation of the Figma Make prototype 'GovTech Framework Development' (branded 'GOV Portal'), inspected on 24 November 2026: every route rendered at desktop (1352px) and phone (400px) width, and the source of all 76 files read by structured extraction. The prototype offers no dark mode. Decisions: Keep = carried over as is; Improve = carried over with sourced facts in place of invented ones; Drop = not carried over; Link = replaced by a link to an existing service that already does the job.
